top_signals.title: Bordeaux Suburbs at Risk as 200,000 Flee Fires in France, Spain
top_signals.summary: More than 200,000 people fled towns in central Spain and southern France overnight as uncontrolled wildfires moved ever closer to the cities of Madrid and Bordeaux.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
